[[XL Center]] |champion= |bowl=[[2012 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result = Round of 64 }} {{2011–12 Big East men's basketball standings}} The '''2011–12 Connecticut Huskies men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Connecticut]] in the 2011–2012 [[National Collegiate Athletic Association|NCAA]] [[Division I (NCAA)|Division I]] basketball season. The Huskies were coached by [[Jim Calhoun]] and played their home games at the [[XL Center]] in [[Hartford, Connecticut]], and on campus at the [[Harry A. Gampel Pavilion]] in [[Storrs, Connecticut]]. The Huskies were a member of the [[Big East Conference (1979–2013)|Big East Conference]]. As punishment for prior recruiting violations, head coach [[Jim Calhoun]] served a three-game suspension, in UConn's first three Big East games (at South Florida, St. John's, at Seton Hall). The team also lost one scholarship, reduced from 13 to 12, and was restricted in other recruiting activities.{{cite web|title=Jim Calhoun to be suspended in 2011–12|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/news/story?id=6146656|publisher=ESPN|access-date=October 21, 2011|date=February 23, 2011}} On February 4, 2012, Calhoun announced he would take an indefinite medical break from coaching as a result of [[spinal stenosis]]. Associate head coach [[George Blaney]] said he would be managing the team during Calhoun's absence.{{cite web|title=Jim Calhoun on indefinite medical leave|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/7537722/connecticut-huskies-coach-jim-calhoun-takes-indefinite-medical-leave|publisher=ESPN|access-date=February 4, 2012|author=ESPN
